import numpy as np
from collections import deque, defaultdict
def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; seen=set(); out=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if (i,j) in seen or g[i][j]==5: continue
            c=int(g[i][j]); q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+di,b+dj
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]!=5:
                        seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
            out[c].append(cells)
    return out

# Per demo: for each singleton (bg-colored isolated cell), find the unique new output comp of its color, record its relation to the template/biggest comp.
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in range(1,9):
    A=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; B=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    bgv=Counter(x for r in A for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ca=comps(A,bgv); cb=comps(B,bgv)
    T=max(ca,key=lambda o:o['sz'])
    singles=[o for o in ca if o['sz']==1]
    res=[]
    for sgl in singles:
        c=sgl['color']; y_,x_=next(iter(sgl['cells']))
        # output comps of same color
        opts=[ob for ob in cb if ob['color']==c]
        # pick one whose bbox doesn't contain the original singleton bbox translation-equivalent... use nearest new comp
        best=None
        for ob in opts:
            # skip if output comp identical to an input comp (unchanged)
            if any(iob['cells']==sgl['cells'] for iob in ca if iob['color']==c and len(iob['cells'])==len(ob['cells'])]):
                continue
            mr=min(y for y,x in ob['cells']); mc=min(x for y,x in ob['cells'])
            d=abs(mr-y_)+abs(mc-x_)
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,mr,mc)
        mr,mc=best[1],best[2]
        n_sh=norm(ob['cells']); Tsh=norm(T['cells'])
        info=f'color{c} at({y_},{x_}) stamp at({mr},{mc}) shape{len(n_sh)} vs Tsize{T["sz"]}'
        # is stamp == T shape exactly (normalized)?
        ok= n_sh==Tsh
        info+=' MATCH-T' if ok else ' NO'
        res.append(info)
    print(f'---demo{p}---')
    for r in res: print('  ',r)

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in range(1,9):
